huro-lst-0119._notes: Huron is a volunteer-run SERVICE UNIT, not a staffed corps. The divisional Service Extension page lists Huron, Erie County, zips 44839 / 44879, phone 419-433-0500. Third-party directories give a different number (419-366-1721) and an address of 820 Cleveland Rd E; the two numbers are NOT reconciled by any first-party source, so only the divisional-site number is proposed below. Yellowpages/countyoffice list 'appointment only' - NOT recorded as hours, no first-party source states it.
huro-lst-0119.description: A Salvation Army Service Unit serving Huron and Erie County. Per the Northeast Ohio Division: "A Service Unit is located in a community church building or other facility, run solely by volunteers, and may offer a full limited array of services such as: Utilities, Prescriptions, Food vouchers and pantries, Gasoline, Rent & lodging, Back to school supplies, Coats for Kids, Residential Camping, Angel Tree".

huro-lst-0132._notfound: THIS PLACE NO LONGER EXISTS. The Huron City Schools district site (huronk12.org, to which the held URL huronhs.com/CentralOffice.aspx now 307-redirects) lists only Woodlands Elementary, McCormick Middle and Huron High School - Shawnee is absent from the school list. The Huron Board of Education voted to close Shawnee Elementary at the end of the 2022-23 school year (last day 2023-05-26) under a consolidation plan, and the building was auctioned and sold for $1.6M. Its address, 712 Cleveland Road E., is now occupied by Huron Sports Academy (huro-lst-0021). Shawnee survives on the district site only as the mailing location of the Title IX Coordinator. No hours, no description, and no phone of its own exist to record. Recommend the listing be marked closed/defunct rather than enriched.
